ratings.comment: I feel like he just isn't the best teacher. He paints himself as a super caring guy but doesn't really give helpful encouragement when teaching, also is passive agressive

Danny is amazing, he really cares for all of his students and really pushes you to be the best actor you can be. Very nice grader but at the same time gives great feedback. I highly recommend taking Theatre 150 with Danny!!

Danny was awesome! Theatre 150 was my very first class that contained acting. I took it for a requirement initially. But he's inspired me to choose more classes for acting. Genuinely the first class I've had where I look forward to lectures. Very caring and warming especially for first time "actors" like myself. Wish he taught more courses!
literally my favorite professor ever. loves his job and goes the extra mile on everything.

Professor Jones is incredibly kind and understanding, especially during these turbulent times. I enjoyed every class and expanded my acting skills immensely, even as someone who has acted before. I highly recommend this course!

This class was genuinely so fun! He definitely cares about his students and grades very individually. Some of the exercises can seem odd, but thats theatre for you. He is very passionate about his work and was able to get some amazing guest speakers! We had around 3-5 performances the whole semester and you're basically graded on improvement.
